comment: Pokemon Tower 7F: Mr. Fuji rescue. The three Rocket placements on this floor (data/trainers.json parties 19-21) are sight trainers the host's trainer system runs; this script is the rescue talk itself, triggered at Fuji once the floor is reached. Its one line resolves through the bridge ref TEXT_POKEMONTOWER7F_MR_FUJI (bank label _PokemonTower7FMrFujiRescueText, the full sourced rescue speech). In the source the scene then relocates to Mr. Fuji's house in Lavender Town, where the PokE Flute grant plays (mr_fujis_house_flute.json, gated on this script's flag) - the relocation warp is host work, so this script fades out and sets fuji_rescued (authored here; no production code set any Fuji flag).
